Using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, players navigate through the dimly lit environment, avoiding the wrath of the spirits. Each area is meticulously designed to heighten the tension, with sounds and visuals working in tandem to create a disorienting experience.

The game's core premise revolves around survival, as players must navigate through increasingly difficult levels, avoiding the clutches of the Pocong and Kuntilanak.
